basic_info.description: Exquisitely remodeled Central Sunset 3BR/4BA home features a stunning open floorplan.The main level has a formal living room with a state of the art fireplace and big-screen TV. The dining room opens to the gourmet chef's kitchen with professional grade Viking appliances. French doors open to a large deck, an inviting garden and a big patio. Upstairs are two beautiful primary bedroom suites. The rear suite has a stylish standing soaking tub and separate shower. The lower level has a great family room with a wet bar, wine cellar and one bedroom and bath. Utility room and 4th bath on the main level. Attached garage with EV charger. Close to Golden Gate Park, shops, restaurants, N-Judah line and easy commute access. Absolutely gorgeous home!
